name: Skin the Cat
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with a shoulder-width overhand grip and straight arms.
Tuck your knees toward your chest, curl your pelvis upward, and smoothly feed your legs between your arms and beneath the bar.
Continue rotating slowly backward until your legs lower behind you into a controlled stretched hang within your comfortable shoulder range.
Reverse the motion slowly by pulling your legs back up and through your arms to return cleanly to the starting hang.
tips: Move slowly and keep your arms straight rather than dropping rapidly into the behind-the-back stretch.
Only lower as deep into the rear hang as your shoulders tolerate comfortably without pinching.
